trap-nonspeakable.notes: CONVENTION FLAG for the report, and the dependence IS determinable here. The block writes the Markov parameter as z(q) = sqrt(q)/(1+q), the EXCISED convention C, and its whole bridge turns on the identity w = z^2 = 1/(2(cosh eta + 1)). I verified that identity holds for C to 1e-31 and FAILS for the canonical convention D (z = q^3/(q^2+1)): z_D^2 = 0.3753866 against 1/(2(cosh eta+1)) = 0.2493208, a 51 pct gap. So the toroidal-harmonic change of variables, the JSJ reading, and the c_lambda evaluation all depend on convention C and do not survive a substitution of z_D.
